root_cause: The audit INSERT query in postgresRepository.GradeAnswer reused positional parameter $2 (graderID) in two conflicting type contexts: (1) as the value for column actor_id UUID, giving PostgreSQL a UUID type constraint, and (2) inside jsonb_build_object() which uses variadic any with no type constraint. PostgreSQL's type inference algorithm cannot resolve a single parameter that appears in both a UUID-typed column context and an untyped variadic-any context, resulting in 'pq: could not determine data type of parameter $2'. Parameters $5 and $6 (sessionID and scorePct) inside jsonb_build_object also lacked type context and required explicit casts.
fix_description: 1. Broke parameter reuse: replaced $2 inside jsonb_build_object with a new 7th parameter $7 (same graderID value), isolating $2 to the actor_id UUID column context only. 2. Added explicit ::text and ::numeric casts to $5, $6, $7 inside jsonb_build_object so PostgreSQL can infer their types. 3. Added slog.Error logging in the handler's default 500 case to make future errors visible in application logs.
